ee:transform.doc:name: Join Sales C with Products D and rename fields

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import leftJoin from dw::core::Arrays var C = vars.salesPayload default [] var D = vars.productsPayload default [] var renamedSaleKeys = [ "shopid", "userid", "routeid", "product_id", "supplier_id", "sale_order_id", "entry_id", "created_at", "payment_status", "packaging", "quantity", "value_sold", "entry_type" ] fun blank(v) = v default "" fun createdAt(sale) = blank(sale.CREATED_AT default sale.Created_AT default sale.created_at) fun invoiceDate(ts) = if (ts contains "T") (ts splitBy "T")[0] else if (ts contains " ") (ts splitBy " ")[0] else ts fun invoiceTime(ts) = if (ts contains "T") ((ts splitBy "T")[1] default "") else if (ts contains " ") ((ts splitBy " ")[1] default "") else "" fun extraSaleFields(sale) = sale filterObject ((value, key) -> !(renamedSaleKeys contains lower(key as String))) mapObject ((value, key) -> { (key): blank(value) }) fun productCode(product) = blank(product.productcode default product.product_code default product.PRODUCTCODE) --- leftJoin( C, D, (c) -> (c.PRODUCT_ID default c.product_id) as String, (d) -> (d.id default d.ID) as String ) map ((item) -> do { var sale = item.l default {} var product = item.r default {} var ts = createdAt(sale) --- extraSaleFields(sale) ++ (product mapObject ((value, key) -> { (key): blank(value) })) ++ { STOREID: blank(sale.SHOPID), SalesRepID: blank(sale.USERID), RouteID: blank(sale.ROUTEID), ProductID: productCode(product), WarehouseID: blank(sale.SUPPLIER_ID), OrderNumber: blank(sale.SALE_ORDER_ID), InvoiceNumber: blank(sale.ENTRY_ID), InvoiceDate: invoiceDate(ts), InvoiceTimepart: invoiceTime(ts), InvoiceStatus: blank(sale.PAYMENT_STATUS), UnitOfMeasure: blank(sale.PACKAGING), Currency: "KES", QuantityInvoiced: blank(sale.QUANTITY), AmountInvoiced: blank(sale.VALUE_SOLD), TransType: blank(sale.ENTRY_TYPE) } })
